name: Knowledge-observatory docs — starter baseline
description: STARTER baseline (loose bands) for the knowledge-observatory documentation corpus — a few how-to queries plus a junk-rejection case. KO docs run hybrid retrieval (rerank-off by design), so this baseline mostly tracks recall over time; the KO owner should tighten bands and add expect_ids once canonical doc ids are known.
